title: Launch uploaded Newick data directly into Table view
observed_behavior: When File Settings `View to Launch` is set to `Table` for an uploaded Newick file, the direct-launch path does not render `.table-wrapper` even though the same Newick fixture can be launched and then opened in Table successfully.
intended_behavior: Uploaded Newick data should honor the selected `Table` launch target and open directly into an interactive Table without requiring a post-launch view switch.
cause_summary: The earlier block was in the direct-launch wiring, not in Newick parsing itself. Once the shared Table launch readiness path was in place, the Newick direct-launch case rendered Table correctly without any Newick-specific follow-up fix.
fix_summary: Keep the maintained direct-launch matrix active for all six uploaded file types so future launch regressions, including Newick, fail directly instead of hiding behind a skip.
notes: Revalidated on 2026-04-04 by unskipping the Newick path in the maintained direct-launch spec; the full six-case smoke matrix now passes.

title: Reapply saved Table filter state when returning
observed_behavior: After applying a Nodes filter, switching to another dataset, and switching back, the saved filter text returns to the input but the filtered row subset is not re-applied; the full Node table renders again.
intended_behavior: Per-dataset filter persistence should restore both the saved filter inputs and the filtered row subset when returning to that dataset.
cause_summary: `createTable()` restored the cached filter metadata but rebuilt the table without replaying those filters through PrimeNG, so the restored UI state and the rendered rows drifted apart after a dataset switch.
fix_summary: Replay the cached per-dataset filters after rebuilding each dataset table so the operator, input text, and visible row subset stay aligned when switching back.
notes: Closed by restoring saved filters through the table API during `createTable()` and verifying the maintained filter-persistence journey passes again.

title: Honor paginator All mode in Table selectedRows logic
observed_behavior: When the Table paginator was set to `All`, applying a filter or switching datasets could leave `selectedRows` stale because the component still looked for the old PrimeNG `.p-paginator-rpp-options` markup that no longer exists in the current paginator DOM.
intended_behavior: Selecting `All` should keep the rendered row count synchronized with the filtered result length and the active dataset length.
cause_summary: The Table component's All-row detection still queried the legacy `.p-paginator-rpp-options span` selector even though the current PrimeNG paginator renders `.p-paginator-rpp-dropdown .p-select-label`.
fix_summary: Updated the Table component and the Cypress helper to use the current PrimeNG paginator selector so the All-row path recalculates `selectedRows` correctly during filter and dataset transitions.
notes: Found while implementing T024. The maintained refresh journey now covers the `All` paginator round-trip and keeps this path closed.

title: Refresh open Table after threshold-driven link updates
observed_behavior: With Table already open, lowering the threshold from 0.015 to 0.0144 updated the global visible-link count but left the Table row degree stale for the affected node.
intended_behavior: An already-open Table should refresh node and link-derived row values after external filtering changes alter the visible graph.
cause_summary: The threshold-change path pre-applied link visibility before `updateNetworkVisuals()` took its change snapshot, so link-only updates never forced the shared refresh signal that open Table relies on.
fix_summary: Forced the post-threshold `updateNetworkVisuals()` call to request a shared open-view refresh and broadened the refresh trigger so Table rebuilds when the visible link set changes.
notes: Found while implementing T023. The maintained refresh journey now asserts that an open Table updates node degree after the threshold change.

title: Rebuild dashboard Table panes after restore and hidden-tab filtering changes
observed_behavior: In dashboard mode, Table could reopen blank after saved-layout restore or keep stale rows after external filtering while the Table tab was hidden.
intended_behavior: Dashboard Table panes should rebuild their active dataset automatically after saved-layout hydration, pane show, and external filtering changes.
cause_summary: Table relied too heavily on active-tab entry paths and did not consistently rebuild its dataset on dashboard restore, pane show, or shared network-update events.
fix_summary: Table now rebuilds through `onLoadNewData()`, pane show, `networkUpdated$`, and `onFilterDataChange()` so hidden dashboard Table panes reopen with current rows instead of stale or empty state.
notes: Closed after the maintained dashboard layout and dashboard filtering specs passed on April 10, 2026.
